title: Free coordinates remain free
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign one of the three restriction states to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. If coordinate $j$ is free after successively fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to the signs encoded by $x$, then $j$ was free in $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ is a restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates
$j$ is free after the listed coordinate updates
